solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: On stretch, hold back

parts.note: re means on or concerning, as in business letters
to strain a muscle or rope is to stretch it

explanation.surface: Advice to someone doing a stretch: keep it held.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold back an impulse or a dog is to curb or check it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Marsh grass ruminant animal pulled up

indicators.note: in a down clue, pulled up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a deer chews the cud, so is a ruminant

explanation.surface: A cud-chewing beast is hauled out of the marsh grass where it grazed.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall waterside plant of the grass family growing in marshes and fens.

clue.text: Item of clothing or clobber

definitions.meaning: a garment worn on the foot

explanation.surface: Clobber is British slang for clothes, so this reads as a garment or one's gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Clobber' is British slang for clothing, which nudges both halves toward garments, but here it is the verb meaning to hit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a piece of footwear and also, as a verb, means to punch someone.

clue.text: Perhaps uncle disheartened lady somewhat

parts.note: an uncle is an example of a family member

indicators.note: taking the heart out of lady leaves only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Some uncle has left a woman a little downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to a moderate degree, in comparison with other things: fairly, comparatively.

clue.text: Disclose rogue paintings, sculptures etc

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous little rascal
these are works of art

explanation.surface: An art-world scandal: reveal the crooked dealer's works.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass on or make known information, as one might reveal a secret.

clue.text: Secure key section of aircraft

parts.note: to secure a prize is to win it
G is a musical key

explanation.surface: An engineer fastening the crucial part of a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: The lifting surface projecting from each side of a plane's fuselage.

clue.text: One with church money for cold snack

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
CE stands for the Church of England
lolly is British slang for cash

explanation.surface: Someone with the church collection spends it on something chilly.
explanation.walkthrough: LOLLY is informal British slang for money.
explanation.definitionFit: A frozen flavoured treat on a stick, what Americans call a popsicle.

clue.text: Little swimmer's winning medal, initially for his swimming

parts.note: the gold goes to the winner

indicators.note: only the opening letter of for is taken
the letters of his are swimming about, rearranged

explanation.surface: A child champion swimmer's gold, the first for him in the pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A small orange carp kept in bowls and ponds, literally a small creature that swims.

clue.text: During flight, Lois half finished a piece of meat

indicators.note: something happening during another sits inside it

parts.note: flight from danger is an escape

indicators.note: only the first half of Lois is completed, the rest dropped

explanation.surface: On a plane, Lois managed only half her meat course.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin slice of boneless meat, often veal, beaten flat and fried.

clue.text: Reportedly mend part of shoe

indicators.note: signals the word is said aloud and a word sounding alike is entered

parts.note: a wound will heal or mend

explanation.surface: A cobbler is said to fix part of a shoe.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised back part of a shoe's sole, under the wearer's rear foot.

clue.text: Teaching high-spirited bishop campanology?

parts.note: someone cheerful is up
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
campanology is the art of bell ringing

explanation.surface: A jolly bishop's lesson in bell-ringing.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's rearing and education, the instruction in manners received growing up.

clue.text: Pro, for most manoeuvres, protected from bad weather

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are manoeuvred into a new order

explanation.surface: A professional, during most military exercises, stays shielded from the rain.
explanation.definitionFit: Built to withstand gales and heavy rain, like a sturdy shelter or jacket.

clue.text: Kind of porcelain: things for poaching by the underworld

parts.note: eggs are commonly poached
hell is the underworld of the dead

explanation.surface: Porcelain by the devil's own kitchen: poaching here sounds like game theft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poaching' suggests illegal hunting but means cooking in simmering water.
explanation.definitionFit: A very thin, delicate, translucent type of porcelain resembling an egg's casing.

clue.text: Tie small daughter, a hazard in the garden

parts.note: a knot is a tie in string
wee is Scottish for small
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: Tying up a little girl would be risky among the flowerbeds.
explanation.definitionFit: Japanese knotweed is an invasive plant that wrecks gardens and foundations.

clue.text: European city's energy embraced by vegan excitedly

indicators.note: one piece is held within the other
the letters of vegan move about excitedly, rearranged

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic vegan hugging a city's vitality.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss city on Lake Leman, home to many international organisations.

clue.text: Doctor renovated sill — uses boring tool

indicators.note: the letters of sill are made over, rearranged

explanation.surface: A medic doing up a windowsill reaches for a power tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Bores holes with a drilling tool, the verb matching the third-person definition.

clue.text: Group of countries anger MEP, disturbed initially

indicators.note: says the rearranged piece comes at the start
the letters of MEP are disturbed into a new order

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: A furious Euro-politician is upset by something about nations.
explanation.walkthrough: MEP means Member of the European Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: Several nations or territories ruled by a single sovereign power.

clue.text: Local community bench chaps built finally

parts.note: a settle is a wooden bench with a high back
chaps are men

indicators.note: only the final letter of built is used

explanation.surface: Some men at last finished building the village bench.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where people have established a community, such as a village or colony.

clue.text: Greek character goes around northern volcano

indicators.note: one piece encircles the other

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek person travels round a volcano in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: The active volcano on Sicily, the tallest in Europe.

clue.text: Unruly youngster runs into club

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a bat is a club for games
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A badly behaved kid runs into a nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoilt, ill-behaved child.

clue.text: Newspaper boss in French place that's heavenly

parts.note: ED is short for editor
en is the French word for in

explanation.surface: An editor somewhere in France finds paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden of paradise, a blissful place.

clue.text: Sloth, for example, tries moving on the left side

parts.note: sloth is one of the seven deadly sins

indicators.note: the letters of tries are moved around

explanation.surface: A sloth tries to shuffle along to the left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sloth' looks like the animal but is the deadly sin.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry, sinister denotes the left-hand side, from Latin for left.

clue.text: Swimming pool in Bali dominated

indicators.note: signals the letters sit inside the following words

explanation.surface: A swimming pool was the main attraction on a Bali holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A public open-air pool, a word from the Venice beach resort.

clue.text: Soldier dispatched to keep gear organised

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: sent means dispatched

indicators.note: the letters of gear are organised into a new order

explanation.surface: A soldier is sent off to sort out his kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-commissioned army officer ranking above corporal.
